question: In December 2021, who among the following became the first-ever Indian male shuttler to play in the final of the BWF World Championship Final?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kidambi Srikanth.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 2, Kidambi Srikanth.**
 
• Srikanth reached the final of the** BWF World Championship Final in December 2021, becoming the first-ever Indian male shuttler to do so.**
 
• Srikanth lost to his opponent, **Victor Axelsen of Denmark, in the final.**
 
• Srikanth has previously won the** BWF Super Series and BWF Grand Prix Gold titles in his career**.
 
• B Sai Praneeth, Chirag Shetty, and V Diju are all accomplished Indian badminton players, but none of them have reached the final of the BWF World Championship Final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **B Sai Praneeth is an Indian badminton player who has won the bronze medal at the BWF World Championships in 2019.**
 
• Chirag Shetty is an Indian doubles badminton player who has won **numerous international titles with his partner Satwiksairaj Rankireddy.**
 
• V Diju is a former Indian badminton player who has won numerous international titles in doubles events.
 
• He is currently a coach and commentator.
